resources.string: Camera not allowed – please allow it for Saga in the Android settings.
While notifications are off on this device, Saga only rings while the app is open. Turn on notifications – Saga uses a distributor such as ntfy or, if none is installed, its own connection.
Your app account is “%1$s”. The browser shows the account signed in there – check that it says “%1$s” before you change anything.
Signing in with another account? If the browser is still signed in with the previous one, sign out of Saga there first.
